title: Understanding Silhouette Score
text: The silhouette score measures how similar a point is to its own cluster compared to other clusters. A negative score indicates that a point is closer to a neighboring cluster than to its own cluster.

title: Analyzing Clustering A
text: Look at the distribution of points in Clustering A. Are there any points that seem closer to a different cluster than their own?
